 Floodwaters fill parking lots, stall cars in Aventura, North Miami and NE Miami-Dade after strong storms roll through
 By Olivia DiVenti , Kevin Boulandier 
 November 17, 2026 
Share 
 NORTHEAST MIAMI-DADE, FLA. (WSVN) - Strong storms rolled through northern portions of Miami-Dade County, leaving parking lots flooded and cars stalled out.
 7News cameras captured standing water in a plaza off Biscayne Boulevard near 179th Street in Aventura on Tuesday night, as the wheels of several vehicles were submerged. The water reached the sidewalk’s curb.
 Data reveals Aventura received four inches of rain on Tuesday night, making visibility for drivers attempting to leave the flooded area very difficult. 
 In other neighborhoods, such as one on Northeast 135th Street and Third Court, flooding was an issue as well. There was also a water main break that made matters worse for residents who live there.
 Authorities urge drivers to turn around and avoid going into flooded roadways if possible.
 The rain and soggy weather is expected to persist through Wednesday as well.
